title: Yochanan HaNazuf
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Shabbat 115a Rabbi Yose relates that Abba Chalafta visited Rabban Gamliel Beribbi in Tiberias and found him sitting at Yochanan HaNazuf’s table, etc. The Tosefta, at the beginning of chapter 3, reads Rabbi Yochanan ben HaNazuf. Tractate Soferim, chapter 5, omits the words Yochanan HaNazuf.

notes.text: Beribbi is an honorific attached to Rabban Gamliel, not a town called Ribbi. The notice preserves HaNazuf, ben HaNazuf and a version omitting the name.
